skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain specific issues related to Information Security
Deploy processes for analyzing, designing, developing, operating, and managing information systems to support solving specific issues related to Information Security
Possess communication skills, manage time and resources effectively, be sensitive and adaptable to changes
Write reports and present specialized topics related to plans, strategies, and execution of assigned activities
Develop skills in analyzing, designing, operating, and managing systems within organizations and businesses
Have self-learning abilities, read and understand specialized literature
Be able to work independently or actively participate in group activities
Adhere to laws and regulations of the organization
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Security
